figures.name: Kamuy Fuchi

ability.name: Eternal Hearth
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all allies; all evil kamuy cannot enter while the hearth goddess burns.

figures.description: The supreme domestic goddess of the Ainu hearth who transmits all prayers to the divine and protects the home.

figures.name: Okikurmi

ability.name: Culture Gift
ability.description: Grant all allies +2 to wisdom and magic from the culture hero's teaching.

figures.description: The Ainu culture hero who descended from heaven to teach humanity all arts of civilization.

figures.name: Repun Kamuy

ability.name: Orca Hunt
ability.description: Grant all fishing and sea allies +3 power; summon one killer whale ally with 7/7/8/5/5 stats.

figures.description: The killer whale deity who appears in the sea as an orca and brings good catches to respectful fishermen.

figures.name: Kim-un Kamuy

ability.name: Bear Spirit Visit
ability.description: Grant all hunting allies +4 power; the bear visit brings sacred meat and gifts.

figures.description: The bear deity who visits the human world in bear form and must be sent back to the divine world with ceremony.

figures.name: Ae-oina Kamuy

ability.name: Ainu Teaching
ability.description: All Ainu cultural abilities gain +2 power; grant +2 wisdom to all allies.

figures.description: The 'kamuy who became an Ainu' who taught humanity and mediated between human and divine worlds.

figures.name: Moshiri Huchi

ability.name: World Grandmother
ability.description: Grant +2 to all stats to every card on your side from the ancient world grandmother.

figures.description: The grandmother of the world who sits at the foundation of the earth and governs all earthly processes.

figures.name: Nitne Kamuy

ability.name: Disease Wind
ability.description: Inflict disease on one enemy: they lose 2 HP per turn for 2 turns.

figures.description: The disease kamuy who sends illness when proper respect is not shown; also capable of healing when appeased.

figures.name: Kotan-kar-kamuy

ability.name: Owl Wisdom
ability.description: Reveal all hidden enemy information; grant +2 wisdom to all kamuy allies.

figures.description: The world-making owl deity who created the earth and its villages and observes all with keen nocturnal eyes.

figures.name: Ainurakkur

ability.name: Divine Guard
ability.description: Grant one ally complete protection from the next attack.

figures.description: The protective divine helper kamuy who assists humans in times of danger when properly called upon.

figures.name: Rimse Kamuy

ability.name: Sacred Dance
ability.description: Grant all allies +2 speed and remove all paralysis from the joy of ceremony.

figures.description: The dance-kamuy who inhabits the sacred ritual performances of the Ainu and elevates the ceremony.

figures.name: Yuk Kamuy

ability.name: Deer Gift
ability.description: When this card is in play, all hunting and food abilities restore 1 additional HP.

figures.description: The deer deity who gives itself to hunters and must be honored with the iyomante ceremony of return.

figures.name: Sea Otter Kamuy

ability.name: Sea Joke
ability.description: Make all enemies laugh: they lose 2 wisdom from distraction for 1 turn.

figures.description: The sea otter kamuy renowned for its sense of humor who makes the other kamuy laugh with its antics.

figures.name: Pisekamuy

ability.name: Sacred Treasure
ability.description: Grant one ally a divine tool: +2 to their highest stat for 2 turns.

figures.description: The kamuy that inhabits sacred treasures and inao prayer sticks, empowering Ainu ceremonies.

figures.name: Inaw Spirit

ability.name: Prayer Conduit
ability.description: This card transmits one ally's prayer directly: guarantee their next ability's maximum effect.

figures.description: The spirit that inhabits the sacred inaw prayer sticks offered to the kamuy in every Ainu ceremony.

figures.name: Turep

ability.name: Food Gift
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to one ally from the sacred plant spirit's nourishment.

figures.description: The water parsley plant spirit that provides essential nourishment to the Ainu people throughout the year.

figures.name: Apemeru-ko-yan-mat

ability.name: Beautiful Blessing
ability.description: Grant one ally +3 magic from divine beauty.

figures.description: The small beautiful divine maiden kamuy who blesses those who maintain proper ceremonial purity.

figures.name: Chironnup

ability.name: Fox Message
ability.description: Deliver a confusing message: one enemy misinterprets their own ability and it backfires.

figures.description: The fox kamuy who carries messages between the human and divine worlds but sometimes causes mischief.

figures.name: Pakoro Kamuy

ability.name: Rain Gift
ability.description: When this card heals an ally, remove one disease effect from all allies.

figures.description: The deity of rain and certain diseases whose nature encompasses both harm and healing.

figures.name: Upopo Singer

ability.name: Upopo Song
ability.description: Remove one debuff from all allies through the healing power of traditional song.

figures.description: The keeper of Ainu traditional songs (upopo) who preserves the oral tradition and maintains ceremony.

figures.name: Yukar Bard

ability.name: Epic Song
ability.description: Reveal the full story of one enemy: expose all their abilities and weaknesses.

figures.description: The Ainu epic bard who sings the Yukar hero tales all night long, preserving divine history in song.
